# developer.paypal.com documentation — Braintree — Docs — Guides — Webhooks

> 4 page(s) of developer.paypal.com documentation — Braintree — Docs — Guides under Webhooks. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Webhooks

- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/webhooks/overview): Webhooks are a system of automated notifications indicating that an event has occurred in your gateway.
- [Create](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/webhooks/create/): Note Webhooks are configured in the Control Panel. Be sure that your user's role has the Manage Webhooks
- [Parse](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/webhooks/parse/): When webhooks are triggered in the gateway, a notification is sent as a POST request to the specified destination URL.
- [Testing](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/webhooks/testing-go-live/): We've provided a sample_notification method to generate a parsable signature and payload.
